notes: A small truthfulness fix and a consolidated ledger. The AFR rating badge on the site is served by afr.im and its grade can change at any time - the pages still described it as 'Rating B' in their alt text while the badge itself now reads A, 91 of 100. A hard-coded grade is a fact that goes stale silently, so the alt text now names the source and lets the image carry the rating. The withdrawal option for the two published skills is written down for the record: withdrawing is an unlisting, not an un-publishing - the pushed history cannot be taken back from anyone who already cloned it. And the single-source-of-truth document now carries one consolidated ledger with every open item's real state, checked against the tree rather than against memory: the development queue is empty, the secrets encryption is implemented and enabled on this machine, the AFR score is verified, and the encryption's live read-and-write acceptance is done. No new credential, no new outbound path.
